metadata.title: Zeros of Pick and Hopf Differentials and Fences of Convex Domains
metadata.abstract: We prove that the vanishing order of a Pick or Hopf differential controls the corresponding convex domain through sharp disk comparisons. For a complete hyperbolic affine sphere, Pick vanishing order $m\ge0$ gives normalized projective coordinates in which the domain lies between disks of radii $\sqrt{\cos(\pi/(m+3))}$ and its reciprocal. For a harmonic diffeomorphism to a convex hyperbolic domain with complete $\partial$-energy metric, Hopf vanishing order $m$ gives a disk in the image of radius $\log\cot(\pi/(2(m+2)))$, centered at the image point. Equality characterizes the corresponding regular polygons. For polygonal targets, these comparisons prove the Fence conjecture of Dumas--Wolf and give explicit Hilbert and hyperbolic distance bounds for higher fences. We also construct simple-zero examples showing that these sufficient multiplicity conditions are not necessary.
metadata.comment: 22 pages, including an AI declaration, some overlap with arXiv: 2610.19664 , comments are welcome

analysis.progressType: 微分零点重数控制凸域的锐比较
analysis.workSummary: 对properly convex射影域及其完整双曲仿射球，Pick微分在p的零点阶m给k=m+3，按U(0)=−1、DU(0)=0、D²U(0)=Id归一化后，以p为中心的内外半径界为√cos(π/k)和其倒数，取等对应正k边形。对到凸双曲域的保向调和微分同胚，若∂能量度量完备，Hopf零点阶m给像点到域边界距离≥log cot(π/[2(m+2)])，等号恰为m≥1时相应中心化正理想多边形。对n边形及2≤s≤n−1，k≥2s保证像点位于第s阶fence且距其边界≥log cot(sπ/[2k])，Pick时用半对数交比规范的Hilbert度量，Hopf时用双曲距离。
techniques: 正多边形模型和零点阶对应的高阶接触
Hartman–Wintner局部节点计数与最大值原理
仿射球余法对偶与径向圆盘比较
CMC图的Legendre变换、支撑函数及凸拼接
圆盘比较到多边形fence的转换
analysis.breakthrough: 归一化后局部差函数的消失阶给出足够多的负分支，模型边数提供全局分支上界，二者比较产生锐半径及刚性。高阶fence中，Pick距离等号要求正k边形且k=2s或k、s均偶，Hopf距离等号对应正理想k边形。临界k=2s的正多边形fence缩成单点，其余情形像点位于fence内部。
analysis.limitations: 补读PDF第1–5、16–17页的主定理、路线及高阶等号，渲染第3–4页。单点Pick圆盘比较依赖指定射影归一化，Hopf比较要求保向、微分同胚及完整∂能量度量。m=0的Hopf普适下界为0，取等模型仅在m≥1。重数条件是充分条件。节点理论、支撑函数分析和全篇比较证明尚未独立核验。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第5页披露第一作者有独立AI辅助Fence证明和Hopf零点类比，与第二作者已有预印本合并。反复与ChatGPT 6 Astra讨论帮助发展高阶零点的锐估计与高阶fence界，属具体核心结果贡献，记录ideas、proofs。初稿由ChatGPT产生，作者逐项检查重写并重组，另记writing。作者说明引入高阶fence和对偶性来自比较两种路线。第18页Astra候选来自a straight boundary。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.24022v1 · PDF第5页Declaration of AI use，全文22页。
